scripts.build:testflight: bash scripts/prebuild-check.sh && cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview --auto-submit --non-interactive --message "main $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.build:preview: bash scripts/prebuild-check.sh --preview && cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview --auto-submit --non-interactive --message "PREVIEW: $(git branch --show-current)" --what-to-test "PREVIEW: $(git branch --show-current)"
